concepts.name: Unit 5 Basics Of Electronics Introductio
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 5 Basics of electronics Introduction Electronic devices inﬂuence our daily lives in such a way that it is almost impossible to spend even a few hours without them
concepts.deep_explanation: Calculators, digital watches, mobile phones, televisions, and computers are just some of the electronic devices that we use every day
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Unit 5 Basics of electronics Introductio from page 148.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Unit 5 Basics of electronics Introductio with adjacent topics in Chapter 5.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 5 Basics of electronics Introduction Electronic devices inﬂuence our daily lives in such a way that it is almost impossible to spend even a few hours without them (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ12ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Calculators, digital watches, mobile phones, televisions, and computers are just some of the electronic devices that we use every day — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 148 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: 144 Unit 5 Basics Of Electronics Of A Co
concepts.simple_definition: 144 Unit 5 Basics of electronics of a covalent bond
concepts.deep_explanation: A covalent bond consists of two atoms sharing a pair of electrons
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 144 Unit 5 Basics of electronics of a co from page 150.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse 144 Unit 5 Basics of electronics of a co with adjacent topics in Chapter 5.
concepts.name_amharic: 144 Unit 5 Basics of electronics of a co (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 144 Unit 5 Basics of electronics of a covalent bond (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ12ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።

concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: 5.1 Semiconductors 145 The Main Aim Of D
concepts.simple_definition: 5.1 Semiconductors 145 The main aim of doping is to make sure that there are either too many electrons (surplus) or too few electrons (deﬁciency)
concepts.deep_explanation: Depending on what situation you want to create, you use different elements for the doping

concepts.simple_definition: 146 Unit 5 Basics of electronics Conduction is due to the majority charge carriers which are holes
concepts.deep_explanation: Here the holes are behaving like positive charge carriers
